raised: The cards are too short to compare products properly, even though the intro promises easy comparison
The "מאיפה להתחיל" section is aimed at salaried workers and has nothing for someone close to retirement
The top row of short-term cards (חשבון עובר ושב, פיקדון, תכנית חיסכון) was cut off, so only the titles showed
It's unclear how קרן כספית מתחדשת differs from a regular קרן כספית
"אחרי תקופה שקבע החוק" doesn't give the actual period
The תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים card is confusing: does a 61-year-old need to move the money now?
"ואינו מתחייב לטווח מניות" in מסלול כללי is unclear: does it mean more risk or less?
The אג"ח cards (צמודה / לא צמודה) are confusing and full of jargon
The index cards are nearly identical, all say the same thing and mean nothing to this reader
מק"מ appears in both halves of the page: is it a place to hold money or a thing to invest in?
"מה האתר עוד לא מכסה" should say straight away what's missing
Only some cards have a "בשפה פשוטה" line; the reader wanted one on every card
The terms קופון, פדיון and תשואת המק"מ aren't explained
The מק"מ auction description is meaningless, and it's unclear whether an individual can buy it
"שווי שוק" and "במשקל לפי שווי השוק הסחיר" aren't understood
The difference between MSCI AC World and MSCI World doesn't seem to matter or isn't explained
Can't tell קרן חדשה מקיפה from קרן חדשה כללית, or which one the reader has
"עד תקרה שנתית" doesn't say what the ceiling is
No management fees (דמי ניהול) are mentioned
No risk levels are shown
Nothing on guarantees if the bank or fund fails
Nothing on what changes at age 60+, such as pension timing and tax
No interest or return figures
No clear path for people close to retirement
Would drop "לבחירה עצמית"
Would drop "לילדים"
Gaps in the screenshots hid some card descriptions

problems.why: The reader is confused that מק"מ appears as a separate entry in both halves of the guide (once where money is held and once in what it's invested in), which is the duplicated-makam-entries problem.
